title: transfinite-predication-cell
description: A predication-cell produced by predicating. Records a Fregean predication: subject (token, bearer), predicate (claim, borne), object (token, bearer), and a FOUR-valued datum inherited from the surrounding articulation-cell partition. Closure regime: transfinite-bounded (omega < kappa < omega_1).
